description: Department of Labour - Special allowance payable to Workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes a special allowance for workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper trade based on the Cost of Living Index. It is issued under the Wages Boards Ordinance and relates to public sector service conditions, specifically worker compensation and benefits, which falls under the Public Service category (Type 8).
